an6.21:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sakkesu viharati sāmagāmake pokkharaṇīyāyaṃ.
an6.21:1.2: atha kho aññatarā devatā abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇā kevalakappaṃ pokkharaṇīyaṃ obhāsetvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho sā devatā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
an6.21:2.1: tayome bhante dhammā bhikkhuno parihānāya saṃvattanti.
an6.21:2.4: ime kho bhante tayo dhammā bhikkhuno parihānāya saṃvattantīti.
an6.21:2.7: atha kho sā devatā samanuñño me satthāti bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatthevantaradhāyi.
an6.21:3.1: atha kho bhagavā tassā rattiyā accayena bhikkhū āmantesi:
an6.21:3.2: imaṃ bhikkhave rattiṃ aññatarā devatā abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇā kevalakappaṃ pokkharaṇīyaṃ obhāsetvā yenāhaṃ tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā maṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi, ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho bhikkhave sā devatā maṃ etadavoca.
an6.21:3.6: ime kho bhante tayo dhammā bhikkhuno parihānāya saṃvattantī”ti.
an6.21:3.8: idaṃ vatvā maṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatthevantaradhāyi.
an6.21:3.9: tesaṃ vo bhikkhave alābhā tesaṃ vo dulladdhā ye vo devatāpi jānanti kusalehi dhammehi parihānāya saṃvattamāne.
an6.21:4.1: aparepi bhikkhave tayo parihāniye dhamme desissāmi
an6.21:4.3: evaṃ bhanteti kho te bhikkhu bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
an6.21:4.5: katame ca bhikkhave tayo parihāniyā dhammā:
an6.21:4.7: ime kho bhikkhave tayo parihāniyā dhammā.
an6.21:5.1: ye hi keci bhikkhave atītamaddhānaṃ parihāyiṃsu kusalehi dhammehi, sabbe te imeheva chahi dhammehi parihāyiṃsu kusalehi dhammehi.
an6.21:5.2: yehi keci bhikkhave anāgatamaddhānaṃ parihāyissanti kusalehi dhammehi. sabbe te imeheva chahi dhammehi parihāyissanti kusalehi dhammehi.
an6.21:5.3: yehi keci bhikkhave etarahi parihāyanti kusalehi dhammehi, sabbe te imeheva chahi dhammehi parihāyanti kusalehi dhammehīti.
